description: The work queue as it concerns you: tasks assigned to you plus, with scope all (the default), the unassigned ones you may claim (open to anyone or to your desk's role), most urgent first, with a summary (open, in_progress, blocked, overdue, done_today). Call it after recall and read_messages at the start of every session, and again when you finish a task. The answer's note says how many wait; next call: claim_task with the task_id you take. Same as GET /v1/in/tasks (owner key: GET /v1/workspaces/:id/tasks, every task). Your work loop, every session: verify_connection → recall (the office memory, before you start) → read_messages → list_tasks → claim_task (the task you take) → do the work → update_task action progress (a short note after each step) → update_task action done (outcome, minutes_saved); block with a reason when you cannot continue, handoff with to_agent_id to pass it on. Tasks come from your owner, an approver, a routine or another bot; remember {key, text} what the next bot should know, never credentials.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is asking.

include_done.description: Office access code only: include done and cancelled tasks.

scope.description: "mine": only tasks assigned to you. "all" (default): yours plus what you may claim. With the office access code, "all" is the whole active board.

status.description: Only these statuses (default: the active ones: open, claimed, in_progress, blocked).

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
